title: Financial Operations Trainee
jobDescription: position-description-hide-1 hide"> About The Organisation: WeMakeScholars is India's Largest Education Finance platform. We are an organization that is funded and supported by the Ministry of IT, Govt. of India, under the Digital India Initiative. Since 2015, we have been helping students in arranging funds for their studies abroad through scholarships and Education loans. With a beautiful office in the heart of Hyderabad, we work as a family of 190 team members. Listen to our story at Josh Talks. Job Description: Your role as a Financial Officer is to be familiar with the underwriting criteria of our partner banks which include SBI, BOB, ICICI, Axis Bank, HDFC, etc. With this knowledge, you will have to discuss with the students to screen the education loan applications, advise them on the documentation, and decide upon a suitable bank loan scheme. Also, you should coordinate with your Team Leaders, for the smooth processing of the education loan. As the initiative is funded under the Digital India campaign, the primary mode of communication is through phone calls or any digital medium and hence the students need not meet our team face to face. Ideal Candidate: You'll love working with us if you are: Looking to build a career in banking finance. Have the ability to pitch to customers with good communication skills & most importantly strong convincing skills. A quick learner who's good at self-improving based on feedback Good at multitasking. Job Perks: Healthy work-life balance with flexible working hours, leaves & work from home policies. The steep learning curve with a great learning experience. Free unlimited beverages & monthly lunches. Friendly work culture, no formals!& much more...!! Package: 5.10 to 6 LPA CTC along with regular performance-based hikes & bonuses.

title: Campus Delegate
jobDescription: position-description-hide-11 hide"> About The Organisation: WeMakeScholars is India's Largest Education Finance platform. We are an organization that is funded and supported by the Ministry of IT, Govt. of India, under the Digital India Initiative. Since 2015, we have been helping students in arranging funds for their studies abroad through scholarships and Education loans. With a beautiful office in the heart of Hyderabad, we work as a family of 190 team members. Listen to our story at Josh Talks . Job Description: Selected intern's day-to-day responsibilities include: 1. Raise awareness about the HEST Scholarship among students planning to pursue higher education abroad in 2026. 2. Support the digital marketing team by leveraging your creativity to engage the target audience through effective communication and outreach strategies. 3. Connect with students preparing to pursue undergraduate or postgraduate studies abroad this year and provide them with relevant information and guidance. Ideal Candidate: You'll love working with us if you are: 1. A Graduate currently looking for an internship (2026, 2027 & 2028 passouts) 2. Are available for a duration of 1 month ( 2-4 hours per week ) 3. Applications across India (any College/University) are accepted. 4. Looking for somebody who is an Extrovert , Responsible, and somebody who is ready to face challenges and learn. 5. If you are looking to pursue a career in Marketing (Digital, Network, performance, and campaign) , this could be your opportunity. Rewards: Cash Rewards up to 16k (Performance Based). Amazon vouchers up to 2k. Letter Of Recommendation from CEO. Certificate of Completion with mention of Digital India Campaign, Ministry of IT, which could be very valuable for your Resume or CV.
